what: 3D miniatures for the SRD 5.2.1 Large (2x2) monster batch (Ogre and Owlbear).
made: 2026-11-27, for Forests and Faeries, at the maintainer's request.
design: Original, generic fantasy tabletop miniatures matching the SRD 5.2.1 stat blocks and the matte painted-miniature style of the existing cast. No third-party geometry, textures, armatures or animation data.
pipeline: Reference images: original orthographic front + 180-degree back turnaround views (plus 90-degree left profile for Owlbear) generated via subscription Gemini image generation (0.00 EUR, no paid image API) matching the approved concepts in neutral symmetric A-pose.

Meshes (2 creatures): Tripo API v3 multiview-to-model, model v3.1-20260211, standard geometry, detailed PBR texture, 40 credits each, on the maintainer's Tripo API account under a code-enforced <= EUR 10 cap (80.0 / 160.0 cr spent, 1 shot each).

Rigged copies (both): Blender 5.2.3 LTS, welded meshes decimated to 18k triangles, 1024 px WebP Color/Normal/ORM textures, normalized to face glTF -Z at 2x2 Large scale (Ogre 2.05 m, Owlbear 1.85 m) with feet grounded at y=0, reusing the project's biped armature, geodesic bone-heat skinning, rigid bone-parented Ogre_Greatclub on Weapon.R, and 9 procedural combat clips.
rights: Generated with the maintainer's own accounts under the terms that applied at the time; no third-party asset is included.

models.placement: faces -Z (glTF), feet at y=0, centred on the vertical axis
models.textures: base colour, normal and occlusion-roughness-metallic, 1024 px WebP

references.subject: Ogre (SRD 5.2.1 Large Giant, CR 2): hulking brutish grey-olive skinned giant in patched hide tunic, rope belt, spiked leather bracers and shinguards, braided dark hair/beard, back quiver of three crude iron-tipped javelins over his right shoulder, gripping a massive spiked wooden greatclub vertically in his right hand (clean gap from right leg for rigid Weapon.R split). Tabletop-miniature sculpt style.

models.placement: faces -Z (glTF), feet at y=0, centred on the vertical axis
models.textures: base colour, normal and occlusion-roughness-metallic, 1024 px WebP

references.subject: Owlbear (SRD 5.2.1 Large Monstrosity, CR 3): ferocious hulking bipedal bear-bodied monstrosity with a great-horned owl's head, glowing amber eyes, curved dark beak, feathered ear tufts, layered mottled ochre-and-brown plumage over shoulders, chest and upper back transitioning into thick shaggy dark-brown bear fur across torso, limbs and stubby tail, with curved black claws on forearms and wide plantigrade hind feet. Hand-painted tabletop-miniature sculpt style.
